decisions.reason: Caption color and text effects are governed by a separate clause in the source message and are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; animations and flashy transitions remain visual-editing treatments.
The visual-treatment change does not alter the caption-font standard; the source message's separate font decision is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
Removing animations and flashy transitions does not change the independently defined requirement to select moments that teach something.
The visual-treatment change does not alter narrative completeness or standalone understandability; those separate source-message changes already have a complete same-message MODIFY.
The clean-editing decision does not change the assigned count or batch obligation; the instruction to redo all eight clips is already represented separately by a same-message MODIFY.
The prohibition on animations and flashy transitions does not change which source material or source video may be selected.
The visual-editing treatment change does not alter the current hook-selection criterion.
Removing animations and flashy transitions does not change the 20-to-120-second duration bounds.
The visual-editing standard does not change the monthly target of 180 approved clips or its counting basis.
